name: Staff — moving a complaint to Under Review records it in the status history

planSteps.description: The complaint currently shows the status Pending
In the status update control, choose "Under Review", type the note "TestSprite automated check" and submit with Save update
A success confirmation appears and the complaint status now reads Under Review, not Pending
The Status history section contains a new entry showing the change from Pending to Under Review
The note "TestSprite automated check" appears against that history entry
